text:
Samir Gupta: FYI Fenwick just sent an RFI and asked for a single-page capability matrix + short written answers focused on data residency, VPC peering, and encryption. They also want a POC quote with explicit line items. I uploaded the RFI here: s3://redwood-sales/fenwick/rfi/fenwick-rfi-2026.pdf

Lena Ortiz: Great — propose we scope a 4-day POC: Day 0 (prep) zero-downtime onboarding + identity mapping, Day 1 ingest & index, Day 2 perf + scale tests (concurrent chat sim), Day 3 embedding quality + handover. Will include a minimal test corpus and a script to replay traffic.

Priya Singh: For the matrix I'll use columns: Feature | Hosted | Dedicated (reserved) | Private (VPC/on-prem) | Notes/Limitations. Add rows: encryption-in-transit, customer-managed keys, HSM support, VPC peering, data residency controls, audit logs & retention, compliance artifacts.

Samir Gupta: They specifically asked whether we can support HSM-backed key wraps and whether we permit key export. Answer: we support BYOK into customer-managed HSMs (PKCS#11/CloudHSM); we do not allow private-key export from HSMs. Mark that clearly.

Tom B. (legal): NDA+DPA required before data ingestion. Also recommend we offer a scoped SOW for the POC that limits data retention to 30 days and includes a mutual test plan. I'll draft the DPA addendum and the SOW template.

Priya Singh: Pricing note: suggest $4k platform credits + up to $1.5k travel/infra stipend if they require on-prem evaluation kit. If they convert to Dedicated commit within 45 days, offer a 25% first-quarter credit. Finance sign-off needed.

Lena Ortiz: For performance targets I'm going to include per-model baseline latencies as "indicative" and call out that Dedicated has configurable autoscale. I'll add "expected throughput: up to 150 concurrent sessions, 7k embeddings/day" based on Fenwick's answers.

Alexa (deploy-bot): Calendar: tentative POC kickoff set for 2026-05-12 09:30 ET. Invite sent to fenwick-ops@fenwick.com.

Samir Gupta: Quick technical addendum for the matrix: runtime isolation is via tenant namespaces + per-tenant process pools on Dedicated. Prefix caching and KV-cache reuse can reduce token cost by ~20% for conversational workloads.

Priya Singh: I'll author the short written answers for the RFI. Key points: we support customer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault), on-prem HSMs for Private, per-tenant key rotation, audit logs, and configurable retention. We'll call out FedRAMP as "roadmap" and offer compensating controls (isolated Dedicated tenancy + SOC2 artifacts).

Tom B. (legal): Also: pen-test requests are fine but must be scheduled; standard window is 10 business days notice. We'll require a scoped plan and escalation contacts.

Lena Ortiz: Small deliverable: sample eval command for embeddings + simple scoring harness in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/tree/main/fenwick. Example curl: 

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["a","b"]}'

Priya Singh: Pushing capability_matrix_fenwick_v1.xlsx and rfi_answers_fenwick.md to s3://redwood-sales/fenwick/deliverables/. Please review today so we can return the RFI by EOD.

Samir Gupta: I'll prepare the SOW template and the tactical runbook for the POC (ingest checklist, rollback steps, contact list).

Tom B. (legal): Draft DPA uploaded to the folder. Ping me with the final SOW and I'll attach NDA and countersign instructions.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks team — if nobody objects I'll send the capability matrix + RFI answers to Fenwick this afternoon. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Finance, legal, and eng aligned. Go for send. :white_check_mark:
